title: Decision
description: What Ormes decided about one video, why, and on what measurements. Produced by services/worker, stored in the decisions table, returned by the API and the webhook.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the decision was written with. Absent means 1. Version 2 added hint, segments and contributor_visible on reasons.

message.description: Human-readable reason shown to reviewers and contributors.

hint.description: One short, actionable sentence for the person who filmed the video, e.g. 'Keep both hands in frame: hold the camera lower.'

segments.description: Where in the video the problem happens, in seconds from the start. Empty or absent for reasons about the whole video.

contributor_visible.description: Whether the contributor may see this reason (message, hint, segments). Absent means true, except originality.*, *.error and pipeline.* reasons, which are always treated as hidden. Originality reasons are never visible: a contributor must not learn how duplicates are detected.

measurements.description: Raw values produced by the check (ratios, durations, detections with timestamps, similarity).

model.description: Which model or method produced the measurements, e.g. 'hands@0.1.0' or 'baseline:gemini'.
